changelog:
Initial public release: enables direct AlphaPortal API access via curl, no MCP server required.

- Capture your AlphaPortal web refresh token once and export it for script use.
- Mint new access tokens and make raw API calls via curl, fully authenticated.
- Supports all read endpoints: students, stops, live vehicle GPS, notifications, etc.
- No runtime browser extension required after initial token capture.
- Write endpoints are live; all issued calls take effect immediately—use with care.
summary: Access AlphaPortal (AlphaRoute) school-bus data — students, stops, live bus GPS location, arrival notifications — from a shell with curl instead of running the alphaportal-mcp server. Capture the signed-in web app's refresh token ONCE (a paste-in-console one-liner, or the fpx browser bridge), then mint access tokens and curl the REST API directly. Use when you want AlphaPortal data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
